definitions.gloss: divine favor; blessing; benefit granted by a god or Buddha
definitions.explanation: The help or good fortune believed to be granted by a deity or Buddha in answer to prayer or devotion, such as success in exams, safe childbirth or prosperous business. Also used jokingly of any benefit something seems to bring.

examples.japanese: {御利益|ごりやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: May it bring us good fortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縁結|えんむす}び→縁結び：14781_enmusubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御利益|ごりやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This shrine is famous for helping people find a partner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}→合格祈願：29108_goukakukigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ったら→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{御利益|ごりやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{第一志望|だいいちしぼう}→第一志望：19697_daiichishibou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}かった→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧。
examples.english: I bought an amulet for exam success, and it really worked: I got into my first-choice school.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written ご{利益|りやく}. The reading りやく, not りえき, marks the religious sense; ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧ is ordinary profit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {御利益|ごりやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to bring blessings, to work
- {御利益|ごりやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{授|さず}かる→授かる：12797_sazukaru⟧: to receive divine favor
- ⟦{商売繁盛|しょうばいはんじょう}→商売繁盛：29953_shoubaihanjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御利益|ごりやく}: blessing of prosperous business

CULTURAL NOTE:
Shrines and temples are known for particular {御利益|ごりやく}: {天満宮|てんまんぐう} shrines for learning, others for matchmaking, safe childbirth or traffic safety. Visitors choose where to pray, and which amulet to buy, accordingly.
